title: Critical Thinking — False Cause Fallacy Example
skills: define and recognize the false cause fallacy
identify when a causal relationship is assumed without sufficient evidence
distinguish correlation or sequence from demonstrated causation
evaluate causal claims for logical support and credible evidence
alignment_note: Provides an example of the false cause fallacy, in which a causal relationship is asserted without adequate evidence. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, causal reasoning, argument analysis, evidence evaluation, and critical thinking across high school English courses.
